source: Sant'Agata Bolognese Export Archives, NHTSA Homologation Files & European TUV Registries

bumperettes_and_crash_structures.impact: US Federal 5-mph bumper regulations (FMVSS 215) forced Lamborghini to bolt heavy rubber bumper extensions onto Countach 5000 QV, Diablo, Murciélago, and early Gallardo.
bumperettes_and_crash_structures.resale_delta: Euro-spec clean bumper cars command a +$15,000 to +$30,000 collector premium in the US market under the 25-year import exemption rule.

emissions_and_horsepower_penalties.countach_lp5000_qv_penalty: European spec with 6 Weber downdraft carburetors produces 455 HP. US spec forced to adopt Bosch KE-Jetronic fuel injection and catalytic converters, dropping output to 414 HP (-41 HP deficit).
emissions_and_horsepower_penalties.diablo_obd2_compliance: 1996+ US Diablos require strict OBD-II dual ECU compliance (LIE engine computers); catalytic converter thermocouple failures frequently trigger false Check Engine lights.

lighting_and_side_markers.dot_regulations: US requires amber rectangular front sidemarkers and red rear sidemarkers embedded in bumper corners. European cars utilize clean front fenders with subtle amber turn indicators.

gulf_middle_east_gcc_spec.thermal_management_package: GCC-spec vehicles (Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Qatar, Saudi Arabia) feature high-output air conditioning compressors, upgraded auxiliary transmission oil coolers, and sand/dust air intake filters.
gulf_middle_east_gcc_spec.collector_considerations: Ex-GCC cars imported to Europe/US often exhibit interior leather shrinkage and dashboard warping from extreme ambient desert heat (>50°C).

japanese_spec_homologation.strict_shaken_compliance: Japanese domestic market (JDM) Lamborghinis feature specialized catalytic exhaust temperature warning sensors, rear license plate illumination brackets, and modified exhaust flapper valve default-closed parameters for noise zoning.

gallardo_tricolore.details: Offset green-white-red racing stripe running over roof, bonnet, and driver's seat. 150 units produced.

gallardo_lp550_2_gz8.details: Exclusive to Guangzhou province; 8 units built featuring metallic orange roof, black carbon wing, and GZ8 emblem.

murcielago_lp670_sv_china_limited.details: Flat matte Grigio Telesto with central orange and black racing stripe; Alcantara interior with Mandarin commemorative plaque.

huracan_avio.details: Matte military paint (Grigio Falco / Verde Turbine) with L63 (Lamborghini 1963) roundels and tricolor aviation cockade.

urus_performante_essenza_scv12.market: Exclusive Private Allocation (Only for the 40 Essenza track-car owners)
urus_performante_essenza_scv12.details: Two-tone livery matching owner's bespoke track hypercar, exposed glossy carbon fiber hood, roof, and 23-inch high-gloss black wheels with red calipers.
